title: Iceberg Blow – Mangue Orange 60ml
description:
Mangue Orange by Iceberg Blow
That blend of an amazing tropical frozen tropical fruit punch. Starting with a strong inhale of fresh and invigorating oranges and on the exhale is finished with sweet ripe mango with an exciting blast of menthol.
Available as a captivating nicotine free e-liquid, Mangue Orange by Iceberg Blow is not to be missed.
Primary Flavours:
Orange, Mango and Menthol
Bottle Size:
60ml
Ratio:
70VG/30PG
Nicotine:
0mg
